title: Register 'rocket tasks' command in Commander
description: Add the 'tasks' subcommand to the Commander program with an optional --filter flag for filtering tasks by status.
acceptanceCriteria: Command description is 'View and manage tasks'
Command is wired to src/commands/tasks.ts handler
rocket tasks --help shows --filter flag with accepted values

steps.details: Create src/commands/tasks.ts exporting: `export async function tasksCommand(options: { filter?: string }): Promise<void> { console.log('tasks command', options) }`

steps.description: Register the tasks command in src/cli.ts
steps.details: Add to program: `program.command('tasks').description('View and manage tasks').option('--filter <status>', 'Filter tasks by status (incomplete | complete | blocked)').action(tasksCommand)`. Import tasksCommand.
Run `npm run dev -- tasks --help`. Should show the --filter flag with its description and accepted values.

technicalNotes: Commander's option('<arg>') means the flag requires a value, while option('[arg]') makes the value optional
